steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Verfremdungseffekt (V-effect / alienation effect): making the familiar strange so the audience THINKS rather than feels — prevents emotional absorption.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Gestus: a combination of gesture and social attitude — reveals the character's social and political position, not their psychology.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Episodic structure: each scene stands alone — prevents narrative immersion, encourages critical comparison between scenes.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Placards and narration: tell the audience what will happen before it does — removes suspense, forces attention onto HOW and WHY.
